nodes.question: What modelling approach was used in the study?
nodes.answer: The Ecopath with Ecosim (EwE) modelling approach, version 6.6.7, was used in the study.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Community conservation|Eco-village conservation models_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the Ecopath model based on?
nodes.answer: The Ecopath model is based on the work originally proposed by Polovina in 1984 and employs two master equations that describe the consumption and production of each functional group included in the model.
